features.name: AL call graph generation
features.description: The ability to generate call graphs showing how code reaches something or flows from one app to another. Part of the latest version of AL tools.

features.name: AL graph command
features.description: Command to query the AL call graph across your apps, allowing cross-app interaction analysis. Part of AL tools capabilities.

features.name: AL graph extract command
features.description: Extracts the call graph from one app or multiple apps depending on folder structure. Can extract all, a specific app, or compile all apps under corpus root as one compilation.

features.name: AL graph export command
features.description: Exports the graph in various formats with query selectors to scope to consumable subgraphs. Supports filtering what parts of the graph are exported.
caveats: Query selector functionality may not work as expected in all cases

features.name: Graph query syntax
features.description: Query language allowing selection of specific object types, namespaces, and debuggable status. Can filter by object types like page and specific names.

features.name: AL graph export and format to DGML
features.description: Tool that exports AL dependency graphs and formats them to DGML format for visualization. Can output to various formats including DGML for viewing with tools like Visual Studio.
caveats: output quality depends on graph file preparation

features.name: AL graph extract whole corpus command
features.description: Command to extract dependency graphs from entire extension codebase. Compiles multiple files together and generates a graph representation of dependencies.
caveats: output file size varies based on extraction parameters

features.name: AL Tool Graph method filtering with selectors
features.description: Feature to filter dependency graphs by specific methods or objects using selector syntax. Allows querying which methods call specific functions like HTTP client operations.
caveats: method specification requires specific notation format
hashtag member syntax needed for filtering

features.name: AL graph visualization using hashtag member notation
features.description: Filtering method using hashtag member syntax to identify specific method overloads and their callers in dependency graphs. Shows where methods like create folder are called throughout the codebase.
caveats: syntax requires hashtag prefix for member specification
documentation on this syntax is limited
